verdict.rationale: Fathom documents self-serve API keys in User Settings, included on all plans, along with a REST API to list meetings and fetch each recording's transcript and summary. Admin keys can read all shared calls across teams, and official TypeScript and Python SDKs handle auth and pagination. Action items are clearly deliverable through registrable webhooks (include_action_items), but the evidence shows no REST pull endpoint for them. Missing for 10: a documented REST endpoint for pulling action items, independent or hands-on corroboration, and a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404).
